actions.command: sh -c 'set -u; PATH=/home/aion/.cargo/bin:/Users/tom/.cargo/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin; export PATH; if [ -z "${HOME:-}" ]; then if [ -d /home/aion ]; then HOME=/home/aion; else HOME=/Users/tom; fi; export HOME; fi; t="$1"; v="$2"; em() { printf "{\"ok\":%s,\"refusal\":\"%s\",\"head_commit\":\"%s\",\"workspace_version\":\"%s\"}" "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4"; exit 0; }; if [ ! -d "$t" ]; then em false "tree directory does not exist" "" ""; fi; h=$(git -C "$t" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$h" ]; then em false "not a git work tree or HEAD unreadable" "" ""; fi; dirty=$(git -C "$t" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep -cv "^??"); case "$dirty" in ""|*[!0-9]*) dirty=0 ;; esac; if [ "$dirty" -gt 0 ]; then em false "tree has tracked modifications — a ceremony publishes exactly what landed" "$h" ""; fi; if [ ! -f "$t/Cargo.toml" ]; then em false "no Cargo.toml at the root of $t" "$h" ""; fi; sect() { sed -n "/^\[$1\]/,/^\[/p" "$t/Cargo.toml"; }; readver() { sect "$1" | grep -m1 "^version *= *\"" | sed -n "s/^version *= *\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/p"; }; wv=$(readver "workspace.package"); src="[workspace.package]"; if [ -z "$wv" ]; then wv=$(readver "package"); src="[package]"; fi; if [ -z "$wv" ]; then em true "" "$h" "(per-crate) neither [workspace.package] nor [package] declares a version key in $t/Cargo.toml — this workspace versions per crate, so the cut witness vouches for nothing here and EVERY crate in publish_order is verified against the declared version by publish_and_confirm before it is published"; fi; if [ "$wv" != "$v" ]; then em false "the $src version $wv does not wear the declared release version $v" "$h" "$wv"; fi; em true "" "$h" "$wv";' -- $tree $version

actions.command:
sh -c 'set -u; PATH=/home/aion/.cargo/bin:/Users/tom/.cargo/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin; export PATH; if [ -z "${HOME:-}" ]; then if [ -d /home/aion ]; then HOME=/home/aion; else HOME=/Users/tom; fi; export HOME; fi; t="$1"; v="$2"; p="$3"; em() { printf "{"dated":%s,"embed_synced":%s,"embed_status":"%s","commit_count":%s,"commits_path":"%s","refusal":"%s"}" "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4" "$5" "$6"; exit 0; }; if [ ! -d "$t" ]; then em false false unmeasured 0 "" "tree does not exist or is not a directory: $t"; fi; mkdir -p "$t/.release" 2>/dev/null || em false false unmeasured 0 "" "could not create the release blackboard at $t/.release"; cp="$t/.release/commits-since-$p.log"; git -C "$t" log --format=%s "$p"..HEAD > "$cp" 2>/dev/null || em false false unmeasured 0 "$cp" "git log $p..HEAD failed in $t — is $p a tag in this repo"; n=$(grep -c . "$cp" 2>/dev/null); n=${n:-0}; case "$n" in ""|*[!0-9]*) n=0 ;; esac; d=false; grep -q "^## $v — 20" "$t/CHANGELOG.md" 2>/dev/null && d=true; if [ "$d" = "false" ]; then em false false not-reached "$n" "$cp" "CHANGELOG.md has no dated section for $v — expected a header of the form: ## $v — YYYY-MM-DD (em dash, ISO date); the changelog refuses before the first publish"; fi; dc="$t/release-ceremony.json"; [ -f "$dc" ] || em true false undeclared "$n" "$cp" "no release declaration at release-ceremony.json in $t — the ceremony will not guess whether this repo embeds its changelog; declare it, repo-owned truth like gates.json, shape {repo, changelog_embeds:[{source,embed}]}. A repo with no embedded changelog declares changelog_embeds as an empty array — that is declared absence and prints a loud not-applicable line. An absent declaration refuses; it never passes"; command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || em true false unmeasured "$n" "$cp" "jq is not on PATH, so release-ceremony.json cannot be read — install jq. The gate refuses rather than skipping a check it could not perform"; jq -e . "$dc" >/dev/null 2>&1 || em true false unmeasured "$n" "$cp" "release-ceremony.json is not valid JSON: $dc"; jq -e "has("changelog_embeds")" "$dc" >/dev/null 2>&1 || em true false undeclared "$n" "$cp" "release-ceremony.json has no changelog_embeds key — declare it explicitly, as an empty array if this repo embeds no changelog. The key is required so that absence is a decision somebody committed, not an omission"; jq -e ".changelog_embeds | type == "array"" "$dc" >/dev/null 2>&1 || em true false unmeasured "$n" "$cp" "release-ceremony.json changelog_embeds must be an array of {source, embed} objects"; k=$(jq -r ".changelog_embeds | length" "$dc" 2>/dev/null); case "$k" in ""|*[!0-9]*) em true false unmeasured "$n" "$cp" "could not read the length of changelog_embeds from release-ceremony.json" ;; esac; sf="$t/.release/changelog-embed-status.txt"; if [ "$k" -eq 0 ]; then { printf "CHANGELOG EMBED GATE: NOT APPLICABLE
"; printf "This repo DECLARES no changelog embeds (changelog_embeds: [] in release-ceremony.json).
"; printf "That is declared absence, recorded here so the ceremony record shows a decision
"; printf "somebody committed rather than a check that quietly found nothing to do.
"; printf "tree=%s version=%s
" "$t" "$v"; } > "$sf" 2>/dev/null; em true true "declared-none: repo declares no changelog embeds — gate NOT APPLICABLE, see .release/changelog-embed-status.txt" "$n" "$cp" ""; fi; i=0; c=0; while [ "$i" -lt "$k" ]; do s=$(jq -r ".changelog_embeds[$i].source // empty" "$dc" 2>/dev/null); b=$(jq -r ".changelog_embeds[$i].embed // empty" "$dc" 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$s" ] || [ -z "$b" ]; then em true false malformed "$n" "$cp" "release-ceremony.json changelog_embeds entry $i is missing source or embed"; fi; case "$s$b" in *..*) em true false malformed "$n" "$cp" "release-ceremony.json changelog_embeds entry $i escapes the tree with .. — paths are tree-relative" ;; esac; [ -f "$t/$s" ] || em true false missing-source "$n" "$cp" "declared changelog source does not exist: $s — fix release-ceremony.json or restore the file, never drop the pair"; [ -f "$t/$b" ] || em true false missing-embed "$n" "$cp" "declared changelog embed does not exist: $b — the repo declares this embed, so its absence is drift and not a not-applicable case"; cmp -s "$t/$s" "$t/$b" 2>/dev/null || em true false drifted "$n" "$cp" "the embedded changelog has drifted from its authored source: $b differs from $s — sync the embed and re-land"; c=$((c+1)); i=$((i+1)); done; { printf "CHANGELOG EMBED GATE: VERIFIED
"; printf "%s declared pair(s), each byte-identical to its source.
" "$c"; jq -r ".changelog_embeds[] | "  " + .source + " == " + .embed" "$dc" 2>/dev/null; printf "tree=%s version=%s
" "$t" "$v"; } > "$sf" 2>/dev/null; em true true "verified: $c declared pair(s) byte-identical to source" "$n" "$cp" "";' -- $tree $version $prev_tag
actions.name: check_changelog

actions.command: sh -c 'set -u; PATH=/home/aion/.cargo/bin:/Users/tom/.cargo/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin; export PATH; if [ -z "${HOME:-}" ]; then if [ -d /home/aion ]; then HOME=/home/aion; else HOME=/Users/tom; fi; export HOME; fi; ulimit -n 65536 2>/dev/null || true; t="$1"; v="$2"; mkdir -p "$t/.release" 2>/dev/null; l="$t/.release/semver-check.log"; if ! command -v cargo-semver-checks >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf "{\"green\":false,\"attested\":false,\"citation\":\"\",\"rc\":90,\"log_path\":\"\",\"refusal\":\"cargo-semver-checks is not installed on this worker host — install it or dispatch with semver_mode attest and a citation\"}"; exit 0; fi; ( cd "$t" && cargo semver-checks --workspace ) > "$l" 2>&1; rc=$?; g=false; [ "$rc" = "0" ] && g=true; r=""; [ "$g" = "false" ] && r="public-surface break detected against the released baseline — read the log"; printf "{\"green\":%s,\"attested\":false,\"citation\":\"\",\"rc\":%d,\"log_path\":\"%s\",\"refusal\":\"%s\"}" "$g" "$rc" "$l" "$r"' -- $tree $version

actions.command: sh -c 'set -u; PATH=/home/aion/.cargo/bin:/Users/tom/.cargo/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin; export PATH; if [ -z "${HOME:-}" ]; then if [ -d /home/aion ]; then HOME=/home/aion; else HOME=/Users/tom; fi; export HOME; fi; ulimit -n 65536 2>/dev/null || true; t="$1"; c="$2"; v="$3"; cr() { printf "{\"crate_name\":\"%s\",\"skipped\":false,\"live\":false,\"checksum\":\"\",\"rc\":%s,\"log_path\":\"\",\"refusal\":\"%s\"}" "$c" "$1" "$2"; exit 0; }; m=""; for f in $(find "$t" -name Cargo.toml -not -path "*/target/*" 2>/dev/null); do if sed -n "/^\[package\]/,/^\[/p" "$f" | grep -q "^name *= *\"$c\" *$"; then m="$f"; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$m" ]; then cr 94 "no manifest under $t declares a [package] section named <$c> — publish_order names a crate this tree does not contain"; fi; mv=$(sed -n "/^\[package\]/,/^\[/p" "$m" | grep -m1 "^version *= *\"" | sed -n "s/^version *= *\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/p"); if [ -z "$mv" ]; then if sed -n "/^\[package\]/,/^\[/p" "$m" | grep -q "^version *\.* *workspace *= *true\|^version *= *{ *workspace *= *true"; then mv=$(sed -n "/^\[workspace.package\]/,/^\[/p" "$t/Cargo.toml" | grep -m1 "^version *= *\"" | sed -n "s/^version *= *\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/p"); if [ -z "$mv" ]; then cr 94 "$c inherits its version from the workspace ($m says version.workspace = true) but $t/Cargo.toml declares no version under [workspace.package] — nothing supplies a version for this crate"; fi; else cr 94 "$m declares no version for $c, and does not inherit one from the workspace"; fi; fi; if [ "$mv" != "$v" ]; then cr 94 "$c wears $mv in $m but the ceremony declares $v — cargo publishes what the manifest says, so this would push $mv while the index confirmation looked for $v"; fi; mkdir -p "$t/.release" 2>/dev/null; l="$t/.release/publish-$c.log"; api="https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/$c/$v"; body=$(curl -s -A aion-release-ceremony "$api"); sk=false; if printf "%s" "$body" | grep -q "\"num\":\"$v\""; then sk=true; printf "already at index\n" > "$l"; else ( cd "$t" && cargo publish -p "$c" ) > "$l" 2>&1; rc=$?; if [ "$rc" != "0" ]; then printf "{\"crate_name\":\"%s\",\"skipped\":false,\"live\":false,\"checksum\":\"\",\"rc\":%d,\"log_path\":\"%s\",\"refusal\":\"cargo publish red — read the log\"}" "$c" "$rc" "$l"; exit 0; fi; body=$(curl -s -A aion-release-ceremony "$api"); fi; n=0; while :; do ck=$(printf "%s" "$body" | sed -n "s/.*.checksum...\\([0-9a-f]\\{64\\}\\).*/\\1/p"); yk=false; printf "%s" "$body" | grep -q "\"yanked\":true" && yk=true; if [ -n "$ck" ] && [ "$yk" = "false" ]; then break; fi; if [ "$n" -ge 2 ]; then break; fi; n=$((n+1)); sleep 20; body=$(curl -s -A aion-release-ceremony "$api"); done; if [ -n "$ck" ] && [ "$yk" = "false" ]; then printf "{\"crate_name\":\"%s\",\"skipped\":%s,\"live\":true,\"checksum\":\"%s\",\"rc\":0,\"log_path\":\"%s\",\"refusal\":\"\"}" "$c" "$sk" "$ck" "$l"; else printf "{\"crate_name\":\"%s\",\"skipped\":%s,\"live\":false,\"checksum\":\"\",\"rc\":92,\"log_path\":\"%s\",\"refusal\":\"published but the index did not confirm a live %s at %s across three reads over 40s — propagation stall or yank; re-run the ceremony with the same input and the skips resume the chain\"}" "$c" "$sk" "$l" "$c" "$v"; exit 0; fi' -- $tree $crate_name $version
actions.name: publish_and_confirm

actions.command: sh -c 'set -u; PATH=/home/aion/.cargo/bin:/Users/tom/.cargo/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin; export PATH; if [ -z "${HOME:-}" ]; then if [ -d /home/aion ]; then HOME=/home/aion; else HOME=/Users/tom; fi; export HOME; fi; t="$1"; v="$2"; m="$3"; tag="v$v"; if git -C "$t" rev-parse -q --verify "refs/tags/$tag" >/dev/null 2>&1; then :; else if ! git -C "$t" tag -a "$tag" -m "$m" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf "{\"green\":false,\"tag_ref\":\"\",\"refusal\":\"git tag creation failed\"}"; exit 0; fi; fi; if ! git -C "$t" push origin "$tag" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf "{\"green\":false,\"tag_ref\":\"%s\",\"refusal\":\"tag exists locally but the push failed — re-run resumes it\"}" "$tag"; exit 0; fi; printf "{\"green\":true,\"tag_ref\":\"%s\",\"refusal\":\"\"}" "$tag"' -- $tree $version $message
actions.name: push_tag

actions.command: sh -c 'set -u; PATH=/home/aion/.cargo/bin:/Users/tom/.cargo/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin; export PATH; if [ -z "${HOME:-}" ]; then if [ -d /home/aion ]; then HOME=/home/aion; else HOME=/Users/tom; fi; export HOME; fi; ulimit -n 65536 2>/dev/null || true; t="$1"; c="$2"; v="$3"; ip() { printf "{\"green\":%s,\"rc\":%s,\"reported_version\":\"%s\",\"log_path\":\"%s\",\"refusal\":\"%s\"}" "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4" "$5"; exit 0; }; if [ -z "$c" ]; then ip false 0 "" "" "declared-none: the ceremony declares no install_probe_crate, so no from-index install was attempted. This is DECLARED absence, not a failed install - the release is not gated on it and the record says so rather than wearing a tick it did not earn"; fi; mkdir -p "$t/.release" 2>/dev/null; l="$t/.release/install-verify.log"; d="$t/.release/install-root"; rm -rf "$d" 2>/dev/null; cargo install "$c" --version "$v" --root "$d" > "$l" 2>&1; rc=$?; if [ "$rc" != "0" ]; then if grep -q "there is nothing to install" "$l" 2>/dev/null; then ip false 0 "" "$l" "not-applicable: $c $v ships no binary target, so a from-index install probe cannot apply to it. Declare install_probe_crate as the crate that carries the binary, or as an empty string when the release ships none. This is NOT a failed install"; fi; ip false "$rc" "" "$l" "from-index install red - read the log"; fi; b=$(ls "$d/bin" 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -z "$b" ]; then ip false 93 "" "$l" "not-applicable: cargo install reported success for $c $v but placed no binary in the install root, which is the shape of a lib-only crate. Declare install_probe_crate as the crate that carries the binary, or as an empty string when the release ships none"; fi; rv=$("$d/bin/$b" --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 | tr -d "\""); g=false; printf "%s" "$rv" | grep -q "$v" && g=true; r=""; if [ "$g" = "false" ]; then r="the installed binary reports <$rv>, which does not carry the released version $v"; fi; ip "$g" 0 "$rv" "$l" "$r";' -- $tree $crate_name $version
actions.name: verify_install
